reading.exact: the gate declines exactly when a signed block reaches an endpoint that checks it
reading.over_decline: the gate declines although nothing bound is on the wire (projection lost, nothing broken)
reading.MISS: the gate lets a pass through although a bound block is on the wire (the failure the gate exists to stop)
reading.out_of_scope: a wire the gate does not cover by design. This is NOT a safety claim: on chat_completions to OpenRouter, Hermes does replay signed reasoning_details (_route_replays_reasoning_details is true), and whether Anthropic checks the binding through OpenRouter or the Portal chat route is unknown (NOT_TESTED). Round 1's PREDICATE counted 'declines nothing on chat_completions' as correct; it was correct only against the gate's scope.
